coreRule.es: No existe un único relato genérico de retracto. El crédito PH122→CAM / art. 1535, el trabajo jurídico de 2018 sobre transmisiones de unidades, el retracto de comuneros de los arts. 1522–1524 CC y los eventuales derechos contractuales/turísticos/de explotación deben analizarse como vías separadas.
coreRule.en: There is no single generic retracto story. The PH122→CAM credit / Article 1535 route, the documented 2018 legal work on unit transfers, co-owner retracto under Civil Code Articles 1522–1524, and any contractual/tourism/exploitation rights must be analysed as separate tracks.

tracks.label: Credit assignment / Article 1535 / PP 1041
tracks.rule: Do not use this track to describe sales of individual hotel units.

tracks.label: 2018 unit-transfer preference workstream
tracks.object: individual Sun Park property interests / units
tracks.evidence: May-June 2018 counsel communications expressly analysed a LUCHY tanteo/retracto against units acquired from minority owners by a third party identified contemporaneously as potentially CAM.
tracks.lawCorrection: The Law 5/1999 transitional paragraph counsel investigated had been repealed by Law 2/2000 and was later declared unconstitutional and null by STC 28/2012. It is not an operative 2018 statutory basis.

tracks.label: Co-owner retracto / Civil Code Articles 1522-1524
tracks.object: undivided share in the same common property
tracks.rule: Requires genuine same-property co-ownership and a sale to an outsider; nine-day period under Article 1524 runs from registration or, failing that, actual knowledge.
tracks.horizontalPropertyBoundary: Civil Code Article 396 excludes a generic tanteo/retracto merely because owners hold different flats/locals in the same horizontal-property regime.

tracks.label: Contractual / tourism / exploitation / insolvency-estate rights
tracks.object: independent transfer, consent, notice, exploitation or estate rights
sources: Canary tourism / unidad de explotación rules
tracks.currentFinding: Registered Sun Park statutes support a single-unit exploitation architecture and continuity into successive titles, but the reviewed passages do not establish a generic first-refusal/retracto over every independent unit sale.

doNotConfuse.es: DP 1041/2017 trató la cesión de crédito hipotecario a CAM y la posible aplicación del art. 1535 CC. Separadamente, en mayo-junio de 2018 consta un trabajo jurídico sobre posibles derechos de adquisición preferente/retracto relativos a transmisiones de intereses inmobiliarios individuales de Sun Park. La existencia de ese segundo trabajo está documentada; la existencia, base jurídica, titularidad y plazo de cualquier derecho ejercitable debe determinarse operación por operación.
doNotConfuse.en: PP 1041/2017 concerned the assignment of mortgage credit to CAM and the possible application of Civil Code Article 1535. Separately, in May-June 2018 the legal team investigated possible preferential-acquisition/retracto remedies concerning transfers of individual Sun Park property interests. The existence of that second workstream is documented; the existence, legal basis, holder and timing of any enforceable right must be determined transaction by transaction.

transactionNodes.label: local 3
transactionNodes.note: Reconcile the 2016 Monte Lanza liquidation/adjudication chain with the later CAM title chain before repeating older allegations about ownership at sale.

transactionNodes.label: local 4
transactionNodes.note: Because the structure was pro indiviso, reconstruct every subsequent share sale, buyer status, registration/knowledge, price and waiver/notice before reaching an Article 1522 conclusion.

transactionNodes.label: apartment 168
transactionNodes.note: The evidence set strongly associates the transaction with Cristina Molina Petit, but seller identity is not promoted to primary-verified until the operative deed/title record closes it.

transactionNodes.label: apartment 180
transactionNodes.note: Any Article 1522 analysis must be performed at each sale date and ask whether CAM was then an outsider or already a co-owner.
Separate retroventa / Inversiones Salinetas / CAM lane around 2018; do not collapse into the Molina track.

entityStandingRule.rule: A group-level economic consequence may be analysed only after identifying the right-holder and standing for the specific transaction.

acCausationRule.dp1041: C5 direct causation is established only for the end of Cristo Suarez Pimentel's specific formal LPB mandate in the Article 1535 workstream.
acCausationRule.unitTracks: Run a fresh C0-C5 causation analysis for every RTB/RTC/RTD right. Do not transfer the DP1041 causation finding automatically.
